qualification: one fresh disposable Truss 0.75 source-custody lifecycle; local PostgreSQL only
database: new WorkerCluster plus new DatabaseFixture; fresh install/seed; 10s statement timeout, 5s lock timeout; fixture cleanup and worker inventory verification required
transactionModePass: admin register consumer: read-write host transaction, committed
person read page/open custody: read-write host transaction; first open rolled back then reopened on same marker and committed
close before-ACK: read-write host transaction, rolled back
wrong-marker renew: adversarial direct SQL within adopted read-write transaction; expects 55P03, rolled back
legacy ACK: public engine method through admitted read-write host; expects contained 55P03, rolled back
active consumer re-registration mutation: direct admin DML, expects trigger 55P03
connection loss/prune/reopen: close person session, admin prune stale, then read-write host open
positive custody renew and Truss fixture ACK: separate read-write host transactions, committed
fresh reconciliation: explicit BEGIN READ ONLY and host.adopt_transaction(access_mode='read_only'); reconcile API only, then rollback
committed custody close: fresh read-write host transaction, committed
ackScope: one disposable Truss source ACK receipt fixture only; no protected Ashlar destination ACK, cloud, publication, push, or migration replay
stopRule: on any refusal/failure, retain exact traceback/result, clean owned fixture, and do not retry
